title: Labour Welfare Officer
description:
JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S POWERING PROGRESS
  
  
Building cities. Driving commerce. Fueling Progress. For over 100 years, Allison has powered the vehicles and technology that move our world forward.
  
  
What powers us? Our employees. Job Title: Labour Welfare Officer
  
  
Sanand (BOL), 382110
  
  
India
  
  
Required Travel: 0 - 10%
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities of a Labour Welfare Officer**

* Provide Labour Compliance Governance & Statutory Coverage by serving as the designated Labour Welfare Officer (a mandatory statutory requirement under applicable labour laws) and ensuring compliance with labour regulations, government inspections, audits, contract labour governance, and related regulatory obligations.
* Lead Government, Union & External Stakeholder Engagement to support regulatory compliance, constructive labour relations, collective bargaining processes, and proactive IR risk mitigation.
* Protect Workforce Stability & Business Continuity through proactive management of industrial relations risks, employee relations matters, conflict resolution, and sustained shopfloor engagement.
* Serve as the designated Labour Welfare Officer in accordance with applicable provisions of the Factories Act and relevant labour legislation.
* Ensure full compliance with labour laws, factory regulations, welfare provisions, social security requirements, and employment legislation.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, notices, licenses, and compliance documentation.
* Coordinate labour inspections, audits, and interactions with Factory Inspectorate, Labour Department, ESIC, EPFO, and other regulatory authorities.
* Ensure timely submission of statutory returns, reports, and government filings.

**Industrial Relations & Employee Engagement**

* Foster positive industrial relations and maintain a harmonious work environment across the plant.
* Act as a trusted resource for employee concerns, grievances, and workplace issues.
* Support grievance handling, dispute resolution, and employee counseling activities.
* Facilitate communication between management and shop-floor employees to improve engagement and mutual trust.
* Participate in employee meetings, engagement forums, and welfare committees.

**Contract Labour Compliance**

* Monitor compliance of contractor workforce deployed within the plant.
* Coordinate with contractor representatives to ensure adherence to labour laws, wage payments, welfare provisions, statutory benefits, and licensing requirements.
* Conduct periodic audits and reviews of contractor compliance documentation.
* Support implementation of company standards for contract workforce welfare and working conditions.

**Government & External Stakeholder Liaison**

* Build and maintain effective relationships with labour authorities, local administration, community bodies, and external welfare organizations.
* Represent the organization during labour inspections, welfare reviews, and statutory interactions.
* Support management on labour-related matters, investigations, and government correspondence.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Track welfare, industrial relations, and compliance metrics and prepare periodic reports for management review.
* Analyze workforce trends and recommend initiatives to improve employee satisfaction and workplace effectiveness.
* Drive continuous improvement in welfare programs and employee engagement practices.

**Key Performance Measures**
**Statutory Compliance**

* Maintain 100% compliance with applicable labour laws, welfare provisions, and statutory reporting requirements.
* Successful completion of labour inspections and regulatory audits without significant non-conformities.

**Contract Labour Governance**

* High levels of contractor compliance with statutory and company requirements.
* Effective monitoring of contract workforce welfare and legal compliance.

**Employee Engagement**

* Increased participation in employee welfare, communication, and engagement programs.

**Functional Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Indian Labour Laws, Industrial Relations and Factory Compliance.
* Thorough understanding of the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSHWC) Code and other applicable labour regulations.
* Employee counseling and grievance-handling capabilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Conflict resolution and negotiation abilities.
* Ability to influence and build credibility across all organizational levels.
* Strong analytical and compliance-focused mindset.
* Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.

**Experience-**

* 5-7 years of experience in Labour Welfare, Employee Relations, Industrial Relations or Plant Human Resources within a manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Knowledge of HRMS and statutory compliance systems.

**Travel or Physical Demands**

* Regular presence on the shop floor and engagement with production employees, supervisors, and contractors.
* Ability to move within manufacturing and warehouse areas while complying with all safety protocols.
* Periodic travel to government offices, labour authorities, training programs, and local community events.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across all levels, from shop-floor associates to plant leadership.

**Location**
– Allison Off Highway, Sanand, Gujarat , India
  
  
**Educational Background**

* Master's Degree in Social Work (MSW) or Master's Degree in Labour Welfare (MLW) from a recognized university. (Mandatory)
* Additional qualification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management, or Human Resources will be advantageous.

**Reporting To -**
Plant HR Manager
  
  

* Apply Now

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**Company Description**
Aquascape Engineers Pvt Ltd is an engineering organization focused on delivering reliable, high-quality solutions to clients in its sector. The company values operational excellence, strong project management, and collaborative teamwork to meet customer expectations. Aquascape Engineers Pvt Ltd promotes a professional work environment where employees are encouraged to grow, take ownership of their responsibilities, and contribute to continuous improvement. The organization emphasizes integrity, safety, and compliance with applicable standards in all its operations. It aims to build long-term partnerships by providing consistent service and support.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Human Resources Generalist role based in Daskroi. The Human Resources Generalist will manage day-to-day HR operations, including employee onboarding and offboarding, maintaining employee records, and assisting with payroll and benefits administration in coordination with relevant teams. The role involves supporting recruitment activities, scheduling interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring a smooth candidate experience. The HR Generalist will handle routine employee queries, support performance management processes, assist with training and development initiatives, and help implement HR policies and procedures. The role also includes supporting compliance with labor laws and company policies, preparing HR reports, and contributing to a positive, inclusive workplace culture.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and HR compliance.
* Ability to maintain accurate HR documentation and employee records, with attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with employees and managers at all levels.
* Organizational and time management skills to handle multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with HR software, spreadsheets, and standard office applications; comfort working with data and basic reporting.
* Knowledge of relevant labor laws and HR best practices; willingness to stay updated on regulatory changes.
* Problem-solving mindset, with the ability to address employee concerns professionally and support conflict resolution.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; relevant HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in an HR Generalist or similar HR role, ideally within an engineering, industrial, or corporate environment.

title: Lead Trainer - L&D
description:
**Job Title: Lead Trainer \- L\&D** 




**Location: Gandhinagar** 




**Shift: 02:00 PM to 11:30 PM** 




  





 Experience: 3 \+ Yrs as a Behavioral/Soft Skills Trainer.
 



 Voice \& Accent Training/Language Training
 



  





 Certification(s): Train The Trainer Certification, or Relevant PG program in Training
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The role primarily of the Lead Trainer is to take up training delivery and content development related activities. The role also entails tasks related to learning management system administration and coordination.
 



  





**What you'll be responsible for:** 




**Training Delivery**




 Manage the learning environment and prepare for training delivery.
 



 Convey objectives and align learning solutions with course objectives and learner needs.
 



 Create a positive learning climate and establish credibility as an Instructor.
 



 Use various learning methodologies to facilitate learning.
 



 Encourage participation and build learner motivation.
 



 Deliver constructive feedback to ensure learning outcomes.
 



  





**Content Development**




 Use instructional design theories and models to design, develop, and/or revamp behavioral and soft skills traning content for virtual and classroom training interventions.
 



 Conduct performance analysis to identify goals, gaps, or opportunities.
 



 Design and implement performance support systems and tools, for example instructional resources, data, process models, job aids, and expert advice.
 



 Design and develop learning assets, for example role plays, self\-assessments, training manuals, job aids, and visual aids that align to a desired learning or behavioral outcome.
 



  





**L\&D Coordination**




 Manage the L\&D functional mailbox while addressing, resolving, and/or escalating all queries and requests in a timely manner.
 



 Release the L\&D training calendar in a timely manner.
 



 Develop, administer, and debrief results of assessments of intelligence, aptitude, potential, skill, ability, and/or interests.
 



 Facilitate career development planning process by coordinating with supervisors/managers for helping employees identify needs and career goals, and prepare and execute individual development plans.
 



 Use data collection tools, for example questionnaires, surveys, and structured interviews to gather real time training needs.
 



 Use qualitative and quantitative data through observations, interviews, focus groups, surveys, and/or assessments to to analyze and showcase training impact.
 



 Help individuals or teams identify goals, develop realistic action plans, seek development opportunities, and monitor progress and accountability.
 



 Coordinate, administer and track the learning interventions as directed by the Learning and Development Manager.
 



 Maintain repository of approved training content.
 



  





**LMS Administration**




 Manage the Learning module of SAP Success Factors.
 



 Maximize the utilization of all the LMS features.
 



 Maintain and develop processes, projects, and tasks related to tracking and publishing management information and training data of all the learning interventions hosted on Success Factors LMS.
 



 Use learning management system and tools to generate learning reports and publish them to the stakeholders in a timely manner.
 



 Work with the other trainer(s) and SLHs to ensure that the requisite training related data is uploaded and accessible on LMS on a real time basis.
 



 Work with the lms consultants to resolve technical glitches and suggest ways to achieve desired outcomes
 



  





 What you'll need
 



 Planning and Organizing
 



 Process Orientation
 



 Communication Skills
 



 Creativity and Innovation
 



 Achievement Orientation
 



 Collaboration
 



 Interpersonal Effectiveness
